summary: Return the focused BrowserWindow or null/undefined-equivalent when none is focused.

target.notes: Return the compatibility wrapper corresponding to the OS-focused BrowserWindow.

caveats: The internal C# representation must preserve the JS absence semantics expected by the compiler (null vs undefined policy).

tests.name: focused window
tests.expected_behavior: returns win if the OS actually focuses it

tests.name: no focused window
tests.expected_behavior: returns the Electron-compatible no-window value when none is focused
